valueChanges.new: A reviewed allowance admits the branches of one block B module that has no base row, for one reviewed token of lexicon.json#/reviewed. It holds only while the tracked file of its module has its sha256, a branch with its use, entry and literal sits exactly at its span (line, column, endLine, endColumn) in that file, the reviewed record named by reviewed binds that span in that file at that sha256, and every row of backingRows (base rows of rule backingRule with its entry and literal and disposition context-generic: the published declarations the key belongs to) has the scope status retained-context. A branch of a package member attributed to the module is bound under the same allowance by its own exception. Any change of the module bytes, of the span or of the token voids the allowance: its branches count again as remaining look selector branches.

valueChanges.old: A scope selector branch exception {row, file, sha256, line, column, endLine, endColumn, use, entry, literal, reason} binds exactly one branch found by the rule: the file's current SHA-256 equals its sha256, a branch with its use, entry and literal sits exactly at its span, its row names an allowance whose use, entry and literal are the branch's and whose module is the branch's module, the scope row of that base row has status retained-context, and the reason is non-empty. Per scanned file and allowance, at most count branches are bound. Every branch not bound by an exception is a remaining look selector branch and fails; an exception binding nothing fails.
valueChanges.new: A scope selector branch exception {row, file, sha256, line, column, endLine, endColumn, use, entry, literal, reason} binds exactly one branch found by the rule: the file's current SHA-256 equals its sha256, a branch with its use, entry and literal sits exactly at its span, its row names an allowance whose use, entry and literal are the branch's and whose module is the branch's module, and the reason is non-empty; a base allowance (allowances) is named by its row and requires the scope row of that base row to have status retained-context, a reviewed allowance (reviewedAllowances) is named by its id and requires reviewedAllowanceRule to hold.
